programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: When MATTHEW DRAPER, a quarry worker is killed by a demolition charge after obeying the orders of his foreman, IAN FRASER, to return to the unexploded device, no one can predict how it might effect the tranquil village of Fletcher's Cross nine years later...

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Barnaby's aunt, Alice Bly (Phyllis Calvert), has an addiction to detective stories, a deep admiration for her favourite nephew, and is recovering from an operation at the Lawnside Nursing Home. When a resident dies, Alice Bly picks up gossip which, mixed with the detective fiction with which she is passing the hours, makes her think that all is not as it should be at Lawnside.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The village of Midsomer Mallow is one of the villages hoping to win the title of the "Perfect English Village" competition. As the story unfolds, not everything is "perfect" as local thief Peter Drinkwater is stabbed with a pitchfork at an abandoned farm, he's using as a squat. Shortly after robbing a retired actor's home. Despite the villagers' best efforts to keep the murder quiet so as to not ruin their chances in the competition, several further deaths occur eventually bringing Detective Chief Inspector Barnaby back several decades to uncover the killer.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Whilst the Upper Marshwood hunt assemble outside the village inn, a filthy tramp-like man leaves the shop and skulks into the wood. Soon after, he hears the sound of the hunt begin and the unforgettable noise of the horses and hounds in hot pursuit of the fox. Running for cover, towards the safety of his home-made shelter, he stumbles and falls into a pit - screaming. LIZA, isolated in the disused railway carriage which constitutes her home, moves deeper into the wood having heard the scream. She finds the pit and sees the tramp lying crumpled on the ground, clearly dead. She stares at him for a moment, then turns and walks away.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: A woman is killed after receiving threatening letters, setting off a chain of murders for DCI Barnaby to investigate.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: In the village of Midsomer Wellow, someone is killing off the bell ringers of the parish church, in the week before a big bell-ringing competition. One young woman on the team is even shot dead in the churchyard on her wedding day.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Some of the residents of Midsomer Worthy are trying to prevent James Harrington from turning Setwale Woods into a housing estate. Led by a solicitor, Bernadette Sullivan, and a local farmer, Simon Bartlett, who also happen to be having an affair, they haven't had much success in court. When Bartlett's wife Victoria is found dead in the woods, Barnaby and Troy must first determine is if her murder is related to the planned development or something as yet unknown. The information provided by two inquisitive children, who see the investigation as a fascinating game, proves invaluable in solving the crime.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: An investigation of a car fire and a bludgeon murder lead Barnaby and Troy to investigate the members of a local reading club which has an agenda that goes beyond books.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Barnaby investigates the murder of a boy during a traditional annual race at an exclusive private school but meets with resentment.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Peter and Caroline Cave are house-hunting in Midsomer Newton. Shortly before leaving their hotel they mention they haven't been able to find what they're looking for; "something old and derelict that they can do up." Anne Merrick tells them about Winyard, a tumbledown cottage in the woods, might be for sale. At the estate agents they are told the house is not yet available for viewing. Later that evening they find the house on their own. However, Caroline has read up on the cottage's haunted reputation and only reluctantly explores it with Peter. The next morning they are found strangled in their own car. DCI Barnaby starts the investigation with the help of PC Ben Jones and they come across the world of estate agents, identical twins, ghosts, piano wire, and more before another body turns up.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Villagers of Midsomer Barton are all set to celebrate Oak Apple Week, especially as the carnival queen event is set to return after an eight year absence. Yet the body of the mother of a deceased, one-time carnival queen, found in a stream, looks set to spoil things, as Barnaby and Jones find themselves digging up the past. From familiar faces, to drunken boasts and hidden obessions, it slowly becomes clear that the mother's daughter might be the key to solving the murder, when more deaths follow.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Wealthy, eccentric and obese aristocrat Freddy Butler drops dead, shortly after gathering all three of his wives at Haddington Hall to make an announcement. Although George Bullard is adamant his death is from natural causes, the case is far from simple when Freddy's solicitor is deliberately killed in a house fire shortly afterwards and Freddy's will goes missing. Barnaby and Jones find themselves investigating the extended Butler family, uncovering hidden secrets, illegitimate children and elusive treasure in the process.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Martin Barrett, a local council clerk living in Midsomer Worthy, is murdered during the night by shotgun, prompting Barnaby and Jones to find a motive for his murder. When they discover that Barrett was an expert blackmailer, his victims become prime suspects for his death - from a local pub landlord, a cleaner, a prominent member of the police board, to a former marine geologist. As they investigate, finding themselves drawn to the seaside, they slowly uncover deception, theft, attempted blackmail and hatred.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: In the village of Broughton, a ninety-year-old battle of the sexes has often occurred, with men trying to oppose an event that the women have managed to successfully hold without interruption, until it culminates with casualties on both sides - Mildred Danvers, an elderly woman who had returned on the day of a funeral and poisoned in her hotel room, and Rev. Anthony Gant, shot during a major event being held in the village green, in view of many. It soon becomes clear someone may have wished to kill both to cover up a dark truth, and soon Barnaby has to figure out who amongst the village wanted both dead, complicated further when Gant's curate is murdered next.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Villagers in Elverton-cum-Latterly are up in arms and divided, over the building of a supermarket. Things soon come to a head when independent environmental supervisor, Frank Hopkirk, is found stabbed to death at a Jubb's Timber Yard, the site of the new supermarket, by a pair of children. When Barnaby and Jones investigate to determine who wanted Hopkirk dead, they find out that he secretly came to the village under various aliases for sexual rendezvous with various women in fantasy role-playing scenarios, and that he had been making further investigations on the future development site and having doubts over claims it was contaminated. Either someone didn't like his investigations, or someone didn't like his sexual appetite, but either way, Barnaby finds himself investigating lies and more to uncover the truth.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Barnaby and DC Ben Jones (Jason Hughes) find themselves attempting to unravel the deaths of a choir tenor, and later a bird watcher, before more murders occur. The case is complicated by a rivalry between the Midsomer Worthy and Aston Wherry choirs, due to compete in an upcoming competition, and suspicions that an art scam is to be conducted, and soon Barnaby and Jones become concerned about a local woman, who they fear may become a victim herself. Particularly when it becomes clear the bird watcher had been photographing suspicious activity of late.

programme.desc: The West Texas desert has a way of pulling you in. In Desert Ghost, Will Cooper heads west to Marathon, Texas, with longtime friend and mentor Cody Roberts to hunt aoudad in one of the most remote landscapes in the state. Rooted in family legacy, this film explores Cody’s deep ties to the desert, the story behind Desert Ghost Distillery, and the mystique of a western oasis near Big Bend National Park. More than a hunt, Desert Ghost dives into the role of aoudad management and its importance to desert bighorn sheep conservation efforts led by Texas Parks and Wildlife and the Wild Sheep Foundation. Sometimes, to protect what belongs here — you have to chase the ghosts. You really do have to be tough, determined, or one lucky bastard to make it out in West Texas.

Cheong Ja decides to return to acting, hoping to restore her former glory and figure out what happened to her. She's assisted by Dokgo Cheol (Song Seung Heon), a former violent crimes detective who got demoted to traffic duty... and who shares a mysterious past connection with Se Ra. To both Cheong Ja and Cheol's surprise, they begin to fall for each other, sending their lives onto an entirely new trajectory.

programme.title: Reencuentros
programme.desc: Al morir su hermano de leucemia, un niño pobre toma su bicicleta y emprende un viaje a la ciudad en busca de su padre.

programme.title: Bello amanecer
programme.desc: La espectacular belleza de una isleña que despierta entre los pescadores las más ardientes y locas pasiones.

programme.title: Señoritas a Disgusto
programme.desc: Tres mujeres que viven en un pueblo lleno de solteronas alquilan una de sus habitaciones a un apuesto hombre.

programme.title: Impaciencia del corazón
programme.desc: Un capitán herido es llevado a un pequeño pueblo y una joven lo cuida. Al final dos mujeres se enamoran de él.

programme.title: El Llanto de los Pobres
programme.desc: Un joven ilegal es acusado por un robo que no cometió, purga una condena en la cárcel donde sueña con volver a su país.

programme.title: La Dinastía de Drácula
programme.desc: Drácula despierta de su tumba después de dormir por tres siglos y reclama más víctimas para su reino.

programme.title: La trenza
programme.desc: Un pueblo confundido por la religión, persigue a una mujer que robó la trenza de la estatua de la Virgen.

programme.title: Más negro que la noche
programme.desc: Tres hermosas mujeres se trasladan a una vieja casona, heredada por la tía de una de ellas, y presencian cosas extrañas.

programme.title: Para que dure no se apure
programme.desc: Un burócrata decide prestarles el departamento a sus jefes para sus aventuras a cambio de dinero y ascensos. Sin embargo, para ello debe dormir en la calle.

programme.title: Fútbol de alcoba
programme.desc: Un equipo de fútbol femenino se dirige a la capital para competir. Para reforzarlo, el entrenador se viste de mujer.

programme.title: El Dandy y Sus Mujeres
programme.desc: Un hombre finge diferentes profesiones para provocar admiración de sus muchas conquistas y recibir dinero de ellas.

programme.title: Me llaman violencia
programme.desc: Una mujer logra escapar de los asesinos de su padre, mientras huye conoce a un hombre que le ofrece protección.

programme.title: Kapax del Amazonas
programme.desc: Una antropóloga norteamericana viaja en un avión con su esposo, periodista y aviador. Se accidentan y caen en la mitad de la selva, él es devorado por las alimañas mientras Linda es rescatada por un aborigen.

programme.title: Mi nombre es Gatillo
programme.desc: Un hombre llamado el "Gatillo" solo tiene violencia en su sangre y su vida está controlada por las armas.

programme.title: El cachas de oro
programme.desc: Un conocido juez persigue a unos violadores y asesinos, hijos de Ramsés, y los mete a la cárcel, pero su padre los libera, por lo que el valiente juez se ve obligado a matarlos. Ramsés se vengará del juez matando a su prometida.

programme.title: Muertes anunciadas
programme.desc: Un niño busca venganza por la muerte brutal de toda su familia, a manos de una banda de asesinos.

programme.title: Mujer de Cabaret
programme.desc: La hermosa y popular cantante de un club nocturno es condenada injustamente por un asesinato.

programme.title: Los dos hermanos
programme.desc: Un hombre rico y poderoso está casado con una mujer mucho más joven, la cual tiene un amante.

programme.title: Amargo destino
programme.desc: Un hombre es encarcelado por un crimen ocurrido accidentalmente y, al salir libre, la mala suerte lo persigue.

programme.title: Yo fui una usurpadora
programme.desc: La amante de un médico le va a dar el hijo anhelado, él se divorcia de su esposa, pero ella le oculta su reciente embarazo.

programme.title: El Amor a la Vida
programme.desc: Un extraño caminante llega exhausto a una hacienda y ayuda a la dueña a arreglar la situación legal de sus tierras.

programme.title: Luna de miel para nueve
programme.desc: Una pareja va a pasar su luna de miel en una cabaña y son invadidos por unos excursionistas que forman nuevas parejas.

programme.title: Bendito entre las mujeres
programme.desc: La historia de dos primos que ignoraban su existencia hasta que su tía Paloma los nombra sus herederos.

programme.title: Encrucijada
programme.desc: El cacique de una región ama a una joven que no le corresponde, e intenta alejar a todo aquel que se acerque a ella.

programme.title: Rayito de Luna
programme.desc: Un joven buceador halla un banco de madreperlas, su padre le da dinero para que compre un velero y saque el tesoro.

programme.title: Adiós Juventud
programme.desc: Al terminar sus estudios, un estudiante de medicina deja a su enamorada quien lo había mantenido durante años.

programme.title: Los Gavilanes Negros
programme.desc: Tres enmascarados negros toman la justicia por su propia mano y protegen a un pueblo dominado por un cacique.

programme.title: Cuánto vale tu hijo
programme.desc: Un niño es atropellado por un auto al salir de la escuela y el conductor ofrece dinero a su familia, quien lo rechaza.

programme.title: Casa de vecindad
programme.desc: En una vecindad varias personas tienen relaciones extramaritales y se desencadenan chismes entre todas las familias.

programme.title: La familia y uno más
programme.desc: Un padre de familia con 16 hijos hace frente a los conflictos, alegrías y los infortunios de una gran familia.

programme.title: Organización criminal
programme.desc: Dos bandas de gánsteres de Chicago rivalizan por el dominio del crimen y a su vez son protegidos por el mismo hampón.

programme.title: Mi preferida
programme.desc: Una pareja viaja en auto y son raptados por una banda, ellos escapan, pero se encuentran al jefe de los criminales.

programme.title: Atacan las brujas
programme.desc: Una bruja muerta hace 300 años, renace de las cenizas para enloquecer a una joven que hereda la mansión de su padre.

programme.title: Tarahumara
programme.desc: Un antropólogo se dirige a la sierra para estudiar los problemas de los indígenas y se entera de que son despojados de sus tierras.

programme.title: Fugitivos
programme.desc: Cuatro sentenciados a muerte se fugan a un pueblo abandonado, juntos liberan presos para poblar con ellos el lugar.

programme.title: El jinete negro
programme.desc: Un ranchero se disfraza como un bandido generoso y asesina a un recaudador de impuestos, pero es descubierto.

programme.title: La Sombra en defensa de la juventud
programme.desc: El luchador enmascarado 'La Sombra' se preocupa por los jóvenes y por ello se enfrenta a la delincuencia organizada.

programme.title: Domingo salvaje
programme.desc: Un jubilado a quien sus padres no quieren queda accidentalmente desnudo fuera de su casa y un niño por correr a verlo se accidenta. Esto hace que el jubilado y la madre del niño se acerquen.

programme.title: Decoding the Secrets of Egyptian Hieroglyphs
programme.desc: Understanding why Ancient Egypt has to invent some form of writing; central to this introduction is a study of the Narmer Palette; its writing sets standards and conventions that would be followed for 3,000 years.

programme.title: Decoding the Secrets of Egyptian Hieroglyphs
programme.desc: Learning the hieroglyphic alphabet; how to write and position each hieroglyph, including a stylized hand, a horned viper and two hieroglyphs for which English does not have a letter; transcribing one's name from English to ancient Egyptian.

programme.title: Decoding the Secrets of Egyptian Hieroglyphs
programme.desc: Wondering how it is possible for a language used by the world's greatest civilization to become lost; charting the rise and fall of Ancient Egypt's kingdoms; investigating the ways Christianity replaces hieroglyphs with Greek letters.

programme.title: Decoding the Secrets of Egyptian Hieroglyphs
programme.desc: Exploring how hieroglyphs and the ability to read them are rediscovered during Napoleon's invasion of Egypt; considering the birth of Egyptology; the role of ushabtis, statues of servants that are buried with prominent Egyptians.

programme.title: World Heritage Sites: Exploring the World's Greatest Places
programme.sub-title: Paleolithic Cave Art of Spain and France
programme.desc: The oldest paintings in the world, in the extraordinary cave art of Altamira, Lascaux, and Chauvet.

programme.title: World Heritage Sites: Exploring the World's Greatest Places
programme.desc: Learning about the builder of Taj, the Mughal emperor Shah Jahan, and his beloved wife Mumtaz Mahal, for whom it was built.

programme.title: World Heritage Sites: Exploring the World's Greatest Places
programme.desc: The Great Barrier Reef is one of the world's natural wonders, drawing travelers to its shimmering, multicolored coral reefs, teeming with fascinating marine life.

programme.title: World Heritage Sites: Exploring the World's Greatest Places
programme.desc: The Mogao Grottoes, dug out of cliffs in the desert of northwestern China, contain one of the most dazzling collections of Buddhist art in the world.

programme.title: World Heritage Sites: Exploring the World's Greatest Places
programme.desc: The citadel of Persepolis was the capital of the Achaemenid Empire for nearly 200 years.

programme.title: World Heritage Sites: Exploring the World's Greatest Places
programme.desc: The moai, the colossal statues of Easter Island, are a testament to human innovation.

programme.title: Herodotus: The Father of History
programme.desc: Identifying key issues of definition and terminology; explaining what is known about the life of Herodotus; background on the ancient Greek world; summarizing the momentous events, particularly the Persian Wars, that spur Herodotus to write.

programme.title: Herodotus: The Father of History
programme.desc: Herodotus is not the first Greek to write about the past; knowing makes him original; how he explains, in the very first sentence of his work and one that richly rewards close reading, the what, why and how of his monumental effort.

programme.title: Herodotus: The Father of History
programme.desc: Knowing how Herodotus deals with the vast and complicated body of traditional narratives that inform the Greek world; how his subject and his angle on it both resemble and differ from older accounts of the ways and causes of things.

programme.title: Herodotus: The Father of History
programme.sub-title: Homeric Epic and the East-West Conflict
programme.desc: For all ancient Greeks, Homer is a pervasive influence; Herodotus models his work on the "Iliad" and the "Odyssey," yet he departs from the Homeric and gives the uniquely Herodotean perspective.

programme.title: The Darwinian Revolution
programme.desc: Pondering why Darwin is so revolutionary; his breakthrough is not in introducing the idea of evolution, which has long been debated, but in proposing how evolution occurs; surveying these and other themes that are developed in the course.

programme.title: The Darwinian Revolution
programme.sub-title: The Way It Used to Be
programme.desc: Examining the traditional worldview in the West, which is based on the biblical account of creation fixed at 4004 B.C.; an allied idea is the Great Chain of Being, pictured as an immutable scale of life forms from the most primitive to God himself.

programme.title: The Darwinian Revolution
programme.sub-title: Theories of Evolution in the 18th Century
programme.desc: Studying three 18th-century thinkers; Benoit de Maillet, who estimates the age of the cosmos; Georges Buffon, who believes living things descend from more primal forms; Pierre Simon Laplace, who proposes a theory for the solar system's formation.

programme.title: The Darwinian Revolution
programme.desc: At the end of the 18th century, fossils are not necessarily regarded as actual remains of living things; they become central to the work of Georges Cuvier, who connects them to extinct species which he believes died out in violent catastrophes.

programme.title: Books That Matter: The Analects of Confucius
programme.sub-title: The Hidden Teaching Dynamic of the Analects
programme.desc: Getting a broader view of Confucius and his style of teaching; examining how the text's performative nature holds its diverse teachings together; exploring Confucius's mission to return China to a more harmonious era in its history.

programme.title: Books That Matter: The Analects of Confucius
programme.desc: The "Analects" should not just be read, but lived; how to enter the book's world by considering Confucius's imaginative ideas about living in society; practicing one's ability to navigate through the book's tangle of information and questions.

programme.title: Books That Matter: The Analects of Confucius
programme.desc: Who Confucius is; how he manages to become one of the most important figures in world history; what historians know about Confucius; the opinions of thinkers like Mencius and Xunzi; several illuminating passages from Chapter 10 of the "Analects".

programme.title: Books That Matter: The Analects of Confucius
programme.desc: The structure of the "Analects" offers a helpful way to understand the text's deeper meanings: breaking down Confucius's book into its chapters, the scattered nature of its tiny nuggets of knowledge, and the generations of historical commentary.

programme.title: Introduction to Paleontology
programme.desc: Taking a virtual walk from the Washington Monument to the U.S. Capitol to explore the 4.54 billion-year history of Earth, with each stride representing 1 to 2 million years; along the way, fossils paint a picture of life on Earth from its start.

programme.title: Introduction to Paleontology
programme.desc: Learning about those whose curiosity about the Earth and its fossils leads to the development of the science of paleontology; studying the geographic, climatic and chemical requirements for a living organism to leave behind its fossilized record.

programme.title: Introduction to Paleontology
programme.desc: In addition to the basic mechanical tools still used in the field today, paleontologists have an exciting digital tool chest; dispersive x-ray spectroscopy and x-ray computer tomography and their use to examine fossils of varying sizes and shapes.

programme.title: Introduction to Paleontology
programme.desc: While the fossilized remains of some organisms are rarely found, the evidence of their existence, as they interacted with the environment, exists; learning how trace fossils help understand the early evolution of the biosphere and animal life.
